chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 475: The Mother Queens' Failed Soul-Seizure & Yu Wei's Heartfiend Tribulation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning resists a soul-search from the Broken Horn World's Mother Queens, triggering an endless siege. Meanwhile, Yu Wei faces her own deadly Heartfiend Tribulation in the Three Realms.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 475: The Siege of Endless Duels Begins
og_description: Cornered by a cosmic army, Ji Ning's only weapon is his will. Across the void, a much different battle begins for Yu Wei.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 475: A War of Wills
twitter_description: The Mother Queens want Heartforce. Ji Ning gives them a fight instead. Meanwhile, Yu Wei enters a battle only she can fight.

lore_anchors.definition: The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; a hostile environment devoid of Dao resonance.
The supreme rulers of the Broken Horn World, ancient and terrifying beings who survived the war against the Three Realms.
The final and most dangerous stage of a Heavenly Tribulation; it attacks the cultivator's Dao-heart and soul with their deepest traumas and hidden sins.
A spiritual violation that forcibly reads a being's memories and potentially controls their soul, considered a fate worse than death.
A formless power of the will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; a key cultivation path for Houyi and the Mother Queens' target in Ji Ning.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't the Broken Horn World just kill Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They want the secrets of his Heartforce technique, which they cannot obtain through a simple kill.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Mother Queens' new plan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They plan to have their 'First Generation' soldiers duel Ji Ning repeatedly, observing his Heartforce fluctuations during combat to deduce the technique themselves over time.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Yu Wei's Heartfiend Tribulation so long?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Her past life as a mad Asura and the deep, unnamed secret she holds give the tribulation immense power, making the battle especially protracted.
